_doc: v3. Coach P's Sweet Science class (MindBody The Sweet Science, Wed 7-8 PM, Pablo Gary). IMG_1868 filmed and sent by Don, Wed 10/7 7:16 PM. Music = DB anthem stems (ElevenLabs two-stem split of different-breed-song.mp3), reel 0 = song 31.3, so the anthem's own pre-chorus leads into the 'We are Different Breed' hook (song 48.96 -> reel 17.66) on the end tag. Instrumental stem under everything (ducked -12 dB under the VO), vocal stem only after the VO ends. Cuts on the anthem beat grid (aubio beat). Each shot plays source 'ms' for (next.at - at). tx = transition INTO the shot.

vo.script: This is the Sweet Science with Coach P. We're not just hitting bags in here, we build the fundamentals, starting with your feet. The band keeps you in your stance, so every punch has a base under it.

shots.note: opener: the whole line from the front, depth to the back wall
wide line from behind, everyone in stance (title over the first 1.5s)
close on the band at the ankles, lands as the beat comes back
alongside the middle of the line
band close from behind, then the line
front of the line coming toward camera
front of the line close, stance, hands up
Coach P out front showing the stance
